title: Never Stalemate
hook: One move ends it. One move throws it away.
why: Mate on the back row. The other queen move leaves him no legal move at all — a draw.
whyLong: A stalemate turns a winning game into half a point. Always leave the enemy king a square, or give mate.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the king you are mating.

glitch.taunt: Bring the queen closer. Squeeze him. Squeeze!
glitch.gloat: No legal moves! Stalemate! It's a DRAW! Hahaha!
glitch.rage: Mate on the back row?! I wanted a draw!

title: Ladder Mate
hook: One rook holds the row below. The other climbs.
why: The second rook lands on the last row. The first one guards the escape.
whyLong: Two rooks mate by climbing like a ladder. Never check for the sake of checking.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the rook guarding his escape row.

glitch.taunt: Check him! Rook to h7! Checks are exciting!
glitch.gloat: You checked. I moved. We can do this all day.
glitch.rage: A LADDER?! Who taught you the ladder?!

title: Don't Check, Take
hook: His pawn is one step from a crown.
why: Take the pawn with the king. The check lets the pawn eat your rook and promote.
whyLong: Before any check, ask what it gives away. A pawn on the second row is a queen waiting.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the pawn one step from a crown.

glitch.taunt: Check with the rook! Drive him off! Go go go!
glitch.gloat: Pawn takes rook. And now I get a QUEEN. Thank you!
glitch.rage: You just... ate it? With the KING?!

title: King First, Pawn Second
hook: One king step wins. Pushing the pawn draws.
why: Take the square in front of the pawn first. Pushing early lets his king sit in front and hold the draw.
whyLong: In pawn endings the king goes first. The pawn only runs once the king owns the road.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the pawn that must wait.

glitch.taunt: PUSH IT! Pawns want to run! Push the pawn!
glitch.gloat: My king sits right in front. Draw. Nothing you can do.
glitch.rage: The KING went first?! That's not how pawns work!

title: Swap the Duds
hook: His bishop guards the corner. Yours guards nothing.
why: Trade your useless bishop for the one doing all his work.
whyLong: His bishop is the only thing stopping your runner. Take it off and run.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap both bishops. One guards the corner.

glitch.taunt: Keep your bishop! Bishops are precious! Tuck it away!
glitch.gloat: My bishop sits on the corner forever. Nothing happens.
glitch.rage: You swapped your WORST piece for my BEST one?!

title: Keep the Good One
hook: His bishop cannot see that side of the board.
why: Keep your bishop. Eat what his cannot guard.
whyLong: His pawns sit on his own colour, so his bishop is stuck. Yours is free.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap the loose pawn and the bishop that cannot reach.

glitch.taunt: Push a pawn! Pawns win endings! Push! Push!
glitch.gloat: Pawns traded, bishops equal. Nothing happened. Perfect.
glitch.rage: My bishop is the WRONG COLOUR?! Since when?!

title: Horse Beats Bishop
hook: The pawns are locked. Horses love locked boards.
why: Trade your bishop for his horse. He keeps the bad one.
whyLong: In a blocked position a horse jumps and a bishop sulks. Leave him the sulker.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap his horse and the bishop stuck behind pawns.

glitch.taunt: Free pawn in the middle! Jump on it! Yum!
glitch.gloat: Your horse is gone for one pawn. Delicious.
glitch.rage: You left me the bishop ON PURPOSE?! Rude!

title: Trade Horses Only
hook: Open board. Bishops run. Horses plod.
why: Swap horses and keep the bishop. It wins a pawn.
whyLong: On an open board the bishop is worth more. Trade the horses, never the bishop.

whyTargets.prompt: Tap his horse and the bishop you are keeping.

glitch.taunt: Your horse is kicked! Hop it back home! Safe!
glitch.gloat: You retreated. I fixed everything. Boring is good.
glitch.rage: You traded HORSES?! I wanted your bishop!
